abstract: Connect OpenCode to self-hosted and gateway models. Covers install and upgrades, opencode.json custom providers for OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, {env:} and {file:} key references, model limits and capability flags, per-engine setup for vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, llama-swap and LiteLLM, the OpenCode 1 versus 2 config split, tool-calling, streaming and reasoning caveats, troubleshooting, and an endpoint probe script.
